blocks.text: Presynaptic neuron ke axon terminal par kai synaptic knobs (ghundiyan) hote hain. In knobs mein bohat si synaptic vesicles (chhoti thailiyan) hoti hain jo neurotransmitters naam ke kimiyai maddon se bhari hoti hain. Jab presynaptic neuron ka action potential synapse tak pohanchta hai to us ki maloomat postsynaptic neuron ya effector cell ko di jati hai. Action potential ka synapse paar karna synaptic transmission kehlata hai. Yeh is tarah hota hai:

items: Jab action potential synaptic knobs tak pohanchta hai to presynaptic membrane ke calcium gates khul jate hain.
Synaptic cleft mein maujood calcium ions tezi se presynaptic axon ke andar diffuse hote hain.

Calcium ions ke andar aane se synaptic vesicles membrane se mil jati hain (fuse hoti hain). Is milap se vesicles ke neurotransmitters exocytosis (cell se bahar nikalne ka amal) ke zariye bahar chhoot jate hain.
Chhoote hue neurotransmitters tezi se cleft mein phail kar postsynaptic membrane ke receptor proteins se jur jate hain.
Neurotransmitters ka yeh jurna postsynaptic membrane ke liye paigham (message) ka kaam karta hai. Us ke Na⁺ gates khulte hain aur postsynaptic membrane mein action potential ban jata hai.

Kaam ke baad neurotransmitters hamesha synaptic cleft mein nahin rehte. Kai synapses par istemal shuda neurotransmitters ko presynaptic neuron wapas jazb kar leta hai. Doosre synapses par enzymes unhein tor dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ka lafz
blocks.text: Kitab ke qadam 5 mein "massage" chhapa hai; is ka matlab "message" (paigham) hai.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: Presynaptic axon mein action potentials jitni zyada baar (frequency) aayen, utne hi zyada neurotransmitters chhoot'te hain.

blocks.alt: Synapse ke teen marhale aur saath kitab ke numbered qadam. Upar: presynaptic neuron ke synaptic knob par action potential pohanchta hai (1). Beech: Ca++ gates khulte (2), synaptic vesicles membrane se milti (3) aur neurotransmitter synaptic cleft mein chhoota hai (4). Neeche: neurotransmitter receptors se judta (5), Na+ gates khulte (6), postsynaptic neuron mein action potential banta (7) aur neurotransmitter wapas jazb hota hai (8).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen hisson ko numberon ke saath parhein. Upar: impulse knob tak aata hai (1). Beech: Ca²⁺ andar aata hai (2), vesicles membrane se mil jati hain (3) aur neurotransmitter cleft mein chhoot jata hai (4). Neeche: neurotransmitter receptors par baithta hai (5), Na⁺ gates khulte hain (6), agle neuron mein naya action potential banta hai (7), aur neurotransmitter wapas presynaptic knob mein jazb ho jata hai (8) taa ke signal band ho sake.

blocks.prompt: Impulse synapse ko sirf ek simt (direction) mein kyun paar karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Neurotransmitter wali vesicles sirf presynaptic knobs mein hoti hain aur receptor proteins sirf postsynaptic membrane par. (Yeh dalil aam biology hai, kitab mein nahin likhi.)

items: Impulse knob tak, calcium gates khulte, Ca²⁺ andar, vesicles neurotransmitter chhorti, neurotransmitter postsynaptic receptors se jurta, Na⁺ gates khul kar naya action potential; phir transmitter wapas jazb ya enzymes se toot jata hai.
